arg.name: ego
arg.description: the world server's ego: default (aib's Tesla), none, or an aib ego config (a car from your repository)

arg.name: world
arg.description: worlds to preload, comma separated: world files, map directories or USDs; the first stays loaded

arg.name: render
arg.description: auto (a window on DISPLAY) | window | headless

arg.name: follow
arg.description: true: no UI, the viewport chases the ego

arg.name: ego_launch
arg.description: the autopilot's launch; empty: aib's Autoware profile; none: no ego

arg.name: side_args
arg.description: name:=value ... for the simulation side (simulation.launch.xml: config_file, weather, gap_trace_dir, npc_motion, contact_report_dir)

arg.name: spawn
arg.description: free drive without a scenario: the ego at x,y,z,yaw (map frame)

arg.name: vehicle
arg.description: free drive: the ego's catalog entry; empty: vehicle_model

arg.name: realtime
arg.description: free drive: pace to the wall clock; false: as fast as it goes (synchronous either way)

arg.name: sim_args
arg.value: ego:=$(var ego) world:=$(var world) render:=$(var render) follow:=$(var follow) physics_hz:=$(var physics_hz)
